g.title: OX02
g.text: Behavior board • DRAFT • OWNER REVIEW PENDING

g.title: selected
g.text: Selected instant is read from catalog state

g.title: typed
g.text: Built from the same selected instant

g.title: composition
g.text: Retained when no weather state OR

g.title: reading
g.text: Used when composition is filtered out
Static debug path verified; runtime unverified

g.title: frame
g.text: Keep caller, trigger, source, and reachability evidence

g.title: state
g.text: Selected from the separate view-only overload

g.title: scope
g.text: Static and runtime evidence stay distinct

g.title: preview
g.text: Static callers verified; not catalog fallbacks

g.title: boundary
g.text: No visible change, fallback removal, or consolidation
OX-02A owns any later consolidation + parity evidence

g.title: exit
g.text: Classify composition, reading, state, and preview routes
Record caller, trigger, source, and verified / unverified reachability
